# GenZee Video Studio

> All-in-one AI voice synthesis and multi-platform content automation studio for YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok creators.

## Overview
GenZee Video (https://www.genzee.video) unites multi-model AI voice synthesis, prompt-to-JSON campaign orchestration, and 1-click social media publishing for creators, agencies, and digital marketers.

## Features & Core Capabilities
- Multi-Model AI Voice Synthesis: ElevenLabs, Google Gemini Voice, and Fish Audio broadcast-grade narration.
- Social Media Automation: Preview, schedule, and publish Facebook Feed posts and Instagram Reels.
- YouTube Strategy Engine: Long-form scripts and Shorts generation from structured campaign prompts.
- Prompt-to-JSON Pipeline: Ingest prompts from Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek into structured calendars.
- Dual-Mode Storage: Cloud database syncing with 100% offline local IndexedDB operation.
